title: Fresher Why-now on repeats
reader_summary: When a Skills repo repeats, remember what we already said so Why-now does not remix the same hook.
how_we_measure: Primary: Why-now uniqueness for repeat repos (lexical overlap with prior Skills briefs) and why-now rubric score. Complements soft-dedup (ranking) with narration memory.

reader_glossary.meaning: Agent memory habits from NousResearch/hermes-agent and affaan-m/ECC: carry prior session facts forward so the model does not repeat itself. We feed prior brief Why-now lines for the same repo into the Skills narrator; we do not run Hermes or ECC.

hypothesis: Feeding prior Skills brief Why-now lines for repeat repos reduces repeated hooks and raises Why-now uniqueness without hurting accuracy.
change_summary: Add DIGEST_WHYNOW_MEMORY=1 and DIGEST_WHYNOW_MEMORY_BRIEFINGS=7 on Skills only.
notes: Queued #4. Inspired by NousResearch/hermes-agent and affaan-m/ECC appearances on the Skills list. Complements soft-dedup (ranking diversity) with narration memory. Lab post: briefings/lab/posts/EXP-20260913-whynow-memory-skills.md.
